note: Prices updated April 2025. June is peak season — book flights and hotels 6+ weeks in advance.

restaurants.note: Budget meal = under €10. Mid-range = €10–20. Avoid Acropolis / Syntagma area — prices 30% higher.

list.tip: Locals only spot, cash preferred

list.name: O Thanasis
list.tip: Queue at lunch, worth it

list.name: Koulouri street bakeries
list.tip: Best breakfast option in Athens

list.name: Atlantikos

list.name: Feyrouz

list.name: Kostas Souvlaki
list.tip: Tiny shop, huge lines — go early

list.name: Central Market (Varvakios Agora)

list.name: Hoocut

list.tip: Splurge dinner option — book ahead in June

list.name: Acropolis of Athens
list.tip: Book online to skip queues — mandatory in June

list.name: Acropolis Museum
list.tip: Glass floor showing excavations below is stunning

list.name: National Archaeological Museum
list.tip: Ticket includes Byzantine Museum, Epigraphic Museum, Numismatic Museum

list.name: Parthenon (inside Acropolis ticket)

list.name: Temple of Olympian Zeus

list.name: Museum of Cycladic Art

list.name: Pnyx Hill

accommodation.tip: Book 6+ weeks ahead for June. Koukaki is cheapest area near Acropolis

food.tip: Cook 2–3 meals in hostel kitchen to cut costs

airport_to_center.tip: Bus X95 to Syntagma is cheapest. Runs 24h

city_transport.tip: One ticket covers metro, bus, tram for 90 min

attractions.tip: Combo ticket (Acropolis + Acropolis Museum + National Museum) = €83 with audio tour included

misc.tip: Tap water in Athens is drinkable — refill bottle everywhere

supermarkets.note: Greece has some of the lowest supermarket prices in Europe (2025 survey). Cheaper than Germany, France, UK, Italy, Spain. Laiki Agora (street markets) even cheaper for fresh produce.

ranking_cheapest_to_expensive.name: Lidl
ranking_cheapest_to_expensive.tip: Cheapest overall. Limited Greek brands but great for basics and private label

ranking_cheapest_to_expensive.name: Bazaar
ranking_cheapest_to_expensive.tip: Least-known by tourists but absolute cheapest for pantry staples. Cash only in some locations

ranking_cheapest_to_expensive.name: Sklavenitis
ranking_cheapest_to_expensive.tip: Best for Greek products (olive oil, honey, cheese, fresh fish). Cheapest basket of 234 products according to e-kalathi 2025

ranking_cheapest_to_expensive.name: Galaxias
ranking_cheapest_to_expensive.locations_athens: Mainly suburban Athens and working-class areas
ranking_cheapest_to_expensive.tip: 100% Greek capital, stocks mostly Greek-made products. Great prices on local brands

ranking_cheapest_to_expensive.name: My Market
ranking_cheapest_to_expensive.tip: More convenient locations for tourists. Slightly pricier but wider range of international products

ranking_cheapest_to_expensive.name: AB Vassilopoulos
ranking_cheapest_to_expensive.tip: Most expensive but best quality and selection. Avoid for budget shopping

street_markets.name: Laiki Agora (λαϊκή αγορά)
street_markets.note: Cheapest fresh produce in Athens — 30–50% cheaper than supermarkets
street_markets.tip: Go 30 min before closing for even cheaper prices — vendors sell off remaining stock

varvakios_central_market.name: Varvakios Agora (Central Market)
varvakios_central_market.note: Athens' main central market since 1886. Meat, fish, spices, olives, cheese
varvakios_central_market.tip: Best place to buy fresh fish and meat at wholesale prices

budget_grocery_tips: Lidl or Bazaar for packaged goods — save 20–30% vs tourist-area shops
Laiki Agora for fruit and vegetables — always fresher and cheaper
Buy 1.5L water bottles in supermarket (€0.29) not from kiosks (€1.50)
Greek yogurt, feta, and olives are cheapest and best quality here
Avoid mini-markets near Acropolis — prices are 2x supermarket
Varvakios market for fresh fish if cooking in hostel kitchen

ground_transport_from_athens.note: KTEL buses cover 80% of Greece. Hellenic Train covers main routes. Both cheaper than flying for nearby cities.

bus_ktel.tip: Book online for e-ticket discount (~€2 cheaper). June is busy — book 1 day ahead minimum.

Terminal_B_Liosion.serves: Central Greece, Thessaly, Volos, Larissa, Meteora (Kalambaka), Thessaloniki

routes.tip: Overnight bus available — saves hotel night
Gateway to ferries for Italy and Ionian islands
Famous oracle site — perfect day trip
Most beautiful town in Peloponnese, very affordable
Cheapest day trip from Athens. Ancient ruins + canal
Monasteries on rocks — one of Greece's most stunning sights
Coastal city, gateway to Sporades islands
Main central Greece hub, useful as transit stop

train_hellenic.tip: Book online — cheaper and no queue. June 2025: reduced schedule due to infrastructure works, only 2 trains/day Athens–Thessaloniki.

routes.tip: Faster than bus. Book in advance — limited seats
Change at Palaiofarsalos. Book early for window seat

travel_to_athens.note: June is peak season — prices 15% higher than shoulder season. Book 6 weeks ahead.

budget_airlines.tip: Cheapest from Bucharest, Sofia, Budapest, Warsaw
Good connections from London, Paris, Amsterdam, Berlin
Best option from Romania, Hungary, Poland, Ukraine

taxi.tip: Fixed rate to city center, negotiate before getting in

🏛️ Athens, Greece — Budget Travel Guide (June 5, 2025)

💰 1-Week Budget: ~€428 (hostel + food + transport + top attractions)

🍽️ Eat cheap:
• Souvlaki pita: €2.50–3
• Koulouri breakfast: €0.50–2
• Taverna dinner: €10–15
• Best spots: O Thanasis, Kostas Souvlaki, Tis Theatrou

🛒 Cheapest supermarkets:
• Lidl — water €0.29, bread €0.69, eggs €1.49
• Bazaar — absolute cheapest, cash only
• Sklavenitis — best for Greek products
• Laiki Agora (street market) — fruit & veg 50% cheaper

🏛️ Top paid attractions:
• Acropolis: €30
• Acropolis Museum: €15
• National Archaeological Museum: €12
• Combo deal: €83 (all 3 + audio)

🆓 Free things:
• Areopagus Hill, Filopappou, Pnyx Hill
• Anafiotika village, National Garden
• Free Walking Tour (tip €10)
• Benaki Museum every Thursday

✈️ Cheapest flights from:
• Sofia → €30 (Ryanair)
• Bucharest → €35 (Wizz Air)
• Budapest → €40 (Ryanair)

🚇 City transport: €1.40/90min or €22 for 3-day pass
🛏️ Hostel dorm: €20–25/night (Koukaki or Monastiraki area)

📅 Book 6 weeks ahead — June is peak season!
